name: Hitozuma Onsen 2 ~Kozukuri Onsen Ryojou~
original_name: 人妻温泉2～子作り温泉旅情～
source:
Jun is now with Akira's mother, Misako.
A year later, while he begins to think about the marriage, Misako brings up an idea of going to a hot spring for 3 days.
However, at the meeting spot on the departure day, he finds both Misako and Akemi waiting...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044878.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
如今，纯和明日香的母亲美佐子在一起。一年后，纯开始考虑结婚，美佐子提出去温泉旅行三天。

然而，在出发日的集合地点，他发现美佐子和明美都在等着自己……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044878.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
